name: fndjob1
label: Heard job from one already worked there

questions.text:
There are many ways people hear about jobs -- such as from ads, employment agencies, or from other people. Could you tell me how you found out about work at your present employer (IF SELF-EMPLOYED:  current organization)?  Please tell me all the ways that you found out about this job.
